defects.claim_says: The catalog See note to Transfer Order 30 of the Secretary of Defense dated December 10, 1948 is a cross-reference whose text is not held and which no held source describes as ending the order; the 1948 hit of the number search is described as a Federal Register concordance page that cites Executive Order 9158 as amended by Executive Order 9242-A.
defects.source_says: The text of Transfer Order 30 is held: jobs/cruden-fr-concordance/output/texts/FR-1948-12-21_p39_734bd5b6ca34.txt (text_sha256 734bd5b6ca344526be0007f4a8d1cfb8f49cd73ba1d6fb1d190fa0b18560c94d; OCR of govinfo FR-1948-12-21.pdf sha256 250ea0c6..., GPO PREMIS match), 13 FR 8163. The 1948 hit of the claim's own number search is that page, which prints Transfer Order 30 (Order Transferring from Department of the Army to Department of the Air Force Certain Functions Pertaining to Decorations and Awards, signed James Forrestal, effective 12:00 noon December 10, 1948, F. R. Doc. 48-11039), whose item k lists 'Executive Order No. 9158 of May 11, 1942 (7 F. R. 3541), as amended by Executive Order No. 9242-A of September 11, 1942 (7 F. R. 7874)'. The earlier-end check therefore rests on a false statement about the held corpus and never reads the held instrument the OFR note points to. On the held text the transfer moves award functions from the Secretary of the Army to the Secretary of the Air Force and does not revoke or alter the in-or-with eligibility wording, so the outcome is probably right, but the stated reasons and search description are wrong.

reasoning: Identity, text and inventory check out: the held 7 FR 7874 text (PDF page 4 of the 1942-10-06 issue) carries EO 9242-A, signed Franklin D. Roosevelt, The White House, September 11, 1942, F. R. Doc. 42-9873 filed October 3, 1942; characters 1535-2383 are its single operative paragraph, and the inventory override correctly drops items 6 and 7 of EO 9242. All quoted spans match the held bytes and hashes. EO 14085 sec. 1(a) (signed and dated 2022-10-03, no separate effective date) struck and inserted words in the first paragraph and left 'in or with' standing; the U.S. Code note prints the paragraph with 'in or with' on a release point current through 2026-10-09, and the OFR notes for the order are only Amends EO 9158 and See Transfer Order 30; no Revoked by or Superseded by note is held. Continuation under the 2026-10-21 strike-and-insert ruling is defensible. The claim is rejected because its earlier-end check and its account of the searches state that Transfer Order 30's text is not held, when the held 1948 Federal Register page that the claim's own number search returned prints Transfer Order 30 and names EO 9158 as amended by EO 9242-A. A claim whose reasons misdescribe the held sources cannot be upheld even when its outcome looks right. A corrected claim should read Transfer Order 30 and state that it transferred award functions without ending the eligibility amendment.

defects.source_says: EO 9242-A is dated The White House, September 11, 1942 (7 FR 7874; claim's own signing_date 1942-09-11; OFR note 'Amended by: EO 9242-A, September 11, 1942'). An effective date of 1939-09-11 precedes both the order and EO 9158 itself (May 11, 1942).

EO 14085 is dated THE WHITE HOUSE, October 3, 2022 (87 FR 60541-60543; claim's own signing_date 2022-10-03; U.S. Code note 'Ex. Ord. No. 14085, § 1, Oct. 3, 2022'); it states no other effective date. The claim's research_rationale itself says signed October 3, 2022, so the field is also internally inconsistent.

defects.claim_says: The catalog See note to Transfer Order 30 of the Secretary of Defense dated December 10, 1948 is a cross-reference whose text is not held and which no held source describes as an ending; only EO 9242-A and EO 14085 name the order apart from reprints and the 1948 and 1954 concordance pages.
defects.source_says: Transfer Order 30 is held: jobs/cruden-fr-concordance/output/texts/FR-1948-12-21_p39_734bd5b6ca34.txt (text_sha256 734bd5b6ca344526be0007f4a8d1cfb8f49cd73ba1d6fb1d190fa0b18560c94d; OCR of govinfo FR-1948-12-21.pdf sha256 250ea0c6..., GPO PREMIS match), 13 FR 8163. It transferred to the Secretary of the Air Force, effective 12:00 noon December 10, 1948, the Secretary of the Army's functions relating to decorations and awards for acts or services with the Air Corps, Army Air Forces or Air Force, vested by or under item k, 'Executive Order No. 9158 of May 11, 1942 (7 F. R. 3541), as amended by Executive Order No. 9242-A'. That is a held later instrument acting on the award authority in the order's second paragraph; the claim misdescribes it as not held and records no later event for it. It does not end the order.
